:::::::::::: column-page-left
# admetshiny **v1.0.1**

### *Espeletia hartwegiana*

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-blue.svg)](https://github.com/xavierclementegarcia/ADMETShiny) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [![R-CMD-check](https://img.shields.io/badge/R--CMD--check-passing-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/xavierclementegarcia/ADMETShiny)

**`admetshiny`** is an open-source R package designed to accelerate drug discovery workflows by unifying programmatic tools and an intuitive dual-interface Shiny application.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Key Capabilities

::::::::::: grid
:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="🔬 Descriptor Calculation"}
Integrates seamlessly with **CDK** and **Webchem** to compute comprehensive molecular descriptors directly within R.
:::
::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="🛠 Data Standardization"}
Standardizes heterogeneous ADMET datasets using the integrated **ADMET Master Manager**.
:::
::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="💊 Drug-Likeness Filtering"}
Applies established filters, including **Lipinski’s** and **Veber’s** rules, for rapid candidate triaging.
:::
::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="🧪 PK Endpoint Prediction"}
Predicts key pharmacokinetic parameters, such as **P-glycoprotein substrates** and **BOILED-Egg** models.
:::
::::
:::::::::::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Advanced Analytics & Visualizations

Automate statistical workflows and generate publication-ready figures with a single command or click:

- **Dimensionality Reduction:** Automated PCA and UMAP projections.
- **Hierarchical Clustering:** AGNES dendrograms based on Tanimoto similarity matrices.
- **Automated Reporting:** Export comprehensive statistical reports instantly.
::::::::::::
